classes.KEEP: An everyday control in one of the four destinations, same key and meaning (it may be relabelled). A state key with no control is KEEP when it is persisted unchanged.
classes.MERGE: Kept in storage, but edited through one control shared with other keys; the control maps each of its values to exact key values.
classes.ADVANCED: Kept, reachable only through a labelled disclosure (the Advanced drawer or a disclosure inside a destination) and through search.
classes.OPERATOR-ONLY: No device control. The value comes from the organization (managed policy, Operator, the server); the device shows the effective value read-only where it matters.
classes.DEPRECATED: No control and no new writes. Read only for migration or backward compatibility, then removed by a versioned migration.
classes.PLATFORM-SPECIFIC: Exists only on the platforms where it has an effect; other platforms neither show nor search it.

legacy.rule: S-1: compute the 1.x route and the 2.0 route from the same layers; where they differ (outside managed cloud-only, a 2.0 value that is a cloud id: the new Cloudflare default, a cloud id left in the user layer by an earlier managed cloud-only profile, or an organization default), write 'unconfigured' to the user layer and offer the S16 choice; where they agree write nothing, so a managed cloud-only profile with no stored provider gets no write; a lock that would change the route holds the profile at version 1. The version is read only from a readable user file and written only by main (when it creates a profile, and when S-1 completes); DEFAULT_SETTINGS declares none and every managed layer's value or lock for it is ignored, so a managed settingsVersion never skips S-1. While settings.json cannot be read, the version and the stored value are unknown, for a legacy and a version-2 profile alike: a route applies only where organization locks fix it at both versions (a locked provider under managed cloud-only, or a locked 'unconfigured' with a locked asrEngine outside it); otherwise no speech session opens, cloud or local, and Voice & meetings shows speech unavailable with typing offered
